images.description: Wide shot of Nepal - mountains or village. Sets the location. You're speaking to camera about Nepalis living with ADHD.
Medicine being mass produced - pill manufacturing. Visual for 'ADHD ko dawai mass produce hunxa'.

A person alone, struggling. Visual for people suffering in silence without treatment.

Person trying glasses for the first time - the moment of clarity. The foreigner bringing glasses to the village.
Beautiful sharp nature - leaves, flowers, birds. What the person sees for the first time through glasses.
Person crying - both happy and sad. Joy of discovery mixed with grief of what was missed.
